children.game_version: Follow-the-leader along straight tape lines on the floor mimicking the slotted movement.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the eight-step count 'one-and-two, three-and-four, five-six' using seated foot taps.
seniors.standing_version: Execute the slotted triple-step and rock-step pattern holding onto a stable barre or chair back.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce music tempo to 100 BPM with small foot movements.

movement_profile.footwork: Six-count, eight-step pattern in a slot: triple step, triple step, rock step
movement_profile.partnering: Partner dance lead and follow in a slot

signature_moves.description: An eight-step pattern over six counts featuring two triple steps and a rock step in a slot.
signature_moves.name: Basic Step

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Triple step, triple step, rock step (one-and-two, three-and-four, five-six)
music_profile.sound_description: Mid-tempo vintage R&B and beach music playing in 4/4 time between 100 and 130+ BPM.

teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on maintaining the slot and keeping footwork smooth during the eight steps across six counts.
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 time signature, 6-count rhythm pattern (triple step, triple step, rock step)
